questions.subject: NP II
questions.stem: A nurse has not practiced for 6 consecutive years and wants to return. Under RA 9173, she must first:
questions.rationale: Nurses inactive for 5 consecutive years undergo 1 month didactic training and 3 months practicum in a Board-accredited hospital.
questions.source: RA 9173, Philippine Nursing Act of 2002, Sec. 26 (Lawphil)
questions.quote: required to undergo one (1) month of didactic training and three (3) months of practicum

questions.subject: NP IV
questions.stem: Which statement about nursing students under RA 9173 is correct?
questions.rationale: The scope-of-practice section does not apply to students performing nursing functions under direct supervision of qualified faculty.
questions.source: RA 9173, Philippine Nursing Act of 2002, Sec. 28 (Lawphil)
questions.quote: this section shall not apply to nursing students who perform nursing functions under the direct supervision of a qualified faculty

questions.subject: NP V
questions.stem: Under RA 9173, what must a nurse do to maintain competence?
questions.rationale: The nurse must maintain competence by continual learning through continuing professional education.
questions.source: RA 9173, Philippine Nursing Act of 2002, Sec. 28 (Lawphil)
questions.quote: The nurse is required to maintain competence by continual learning

questions.subject: NP II
questions.stem: Which nursing act is within the independent scope of RA 9173?
questions.rationale: Providing health education to individuals, families and communities is listed in the nurse's scope; prescribing and medical diagnosis are not.
questions.source: RA 9173, Philippine Nursing Act of 2002, Sec. 28(c) (Lawphil)
questions.quote: Provide health education to individuals, families and communities

questions.subject: NP IV
questions.stem: A staff nurse wants to become a nurse supervisor. Under RA 9173, what experience does she need?
questions.rationale: Supervisory or managerial posts need 2 years in nursing service administration and 9 graduate units in management.
questions.source: RA 9173, Philippine Nursing Act of 2002, Sec. 29 (Lawphil)
questions.quote: Have at least two (2) years experience in general nursing service administration

questions.subject: NP IV
questions.stem: A nurse wants to teach professional nursing courses. Which qualification does RA 9173 require?
questions.rationale: Faculty must be RNs with at least 1 year of clinical practice in a specialty, APO membership and a master's degree.
questions.source: RA 9173, Philippine Nursing Act of 2002, Sec. 27 (Lawphil)
questions.quote: Have at least one (1) year of clinical practice in a field of specialization

questions.subject: NP V
questions.stem: A BSN graduate who has not passed the board signs 'RN' after her name. This is:
questions.rationale: Appending BSN/RN without having the degree or registration is penalized under Sec. 35.
questions.source: RA 9173, Philippine Nursing Act of 2002, Sec. 35 (Lawphil)
questions.quote: who appends B.S.N./R.N. (Bachelor of Science in Nursing/Registered Nurse) or any similar appendage to his/her name

questions.subject: NP IV
questions.stem: An RN lets an unlicensed relative give injections at her clinic. Under RA 9173 the RN:
questions.rationale: A licensed nurse who abets or assists the illegal practice of an unqualified person is penalized.
questions.source: RA 9173, Philippine Nursing Act of 2002, Sec. 35 (Lawphil)
questions.quote: abets or assists the illegal practice of a person who is not lawfully qualified to practice nursing

questions.subject: NP II
questions.stem: Under RA 9173, what is the minimum salary grade for nurses in public health institutions?
questions.rationale: Minimum base pay of nurses in public health institutions shall not be lower than SG 15.
questions.source: RA 9173, Philippine Nursing Act of 2002, Sec. 32 (Lawphil)
questions.quote: shall not be lower than salary grade 15

questions.subject: NP V
questions.stem: Before practicing, a nurse who passed the board must first:
questions.rationale: Successful examinees take an oath before the Board or an authorized official before entering practice.
questions.source: RA 9173, Philippine Nursing Act of 2002, Sec. 16 (Lawphil)
questions.quote: required to take an oath of profession before the Board

questions.subject: NP IV
questions.stem: Under RA 9173, who promulgates the Code of Ethics for nurses?
options: Board of Nursing with the APO
questions.rationale: The Board promulgates the Code of Ethics in coordination with the accredited professional organization.
questions.source: RA 9173, Philippine Nursing Act of 2002, Sec. 9(f) (Lawphil)
questions.quote: Promulgate a Code of Ethics in coordination and consultation with the accredited professional organization of nurses

questions.subject: NP V
questions.stem: Which ground allows the Board to revoke a nurse's license?
questions.rationale: Grounds include unethical conduct, gross incompetence, malpractice or negligence, and fraud.
questions.source: RA 9173, Philippine Nursing Act of 2002, Sec. 23 (Lawphil)
questions.quote: For malpractice or negligence in the practice of nursing

questions.subject: NP IV
questions.stem: Under the Generics Act, government nurses must use which name when administering drugs?
questions.rationale: Government health personnel use generic names in purchasing, prescribing, dispensing and administering drugs.
questions.source: RA 6675, Generics Act of 1988, Sec. 6(a) (Lawphil)
questions.quote: shall use generic terminology or generic names in all transactions related to purchasing, prescribing, dispensing and administering of drugs

questions.subject: NP IV
questions.stem: Under the Generics Act, a pharmacy must tell the buyer about:
questions.rationale: Drug outlets must inform buyers of all products with the same generic name and their prices.
questions.source: RA 6675, Generics Act of 1988, Sec. 6(d) (Lawphil)
questions.quote: shall inform any buyer about any and all other drug products having the same generic name

questions.subject: NP V
questions.stem: A woman in active labor arrives at a private hospital without money. Under RA 10932 the hospital must:
questions.rationale: Demanding a deposit before basic emergency care is unlawful; care for a woman in active labor is basic emergency care.
questions.source: RA 10932, amending BP 702 (Anti-Hospital Deposit Law), Sec. 1–2 (Lawphil)
questions.quote: necessary medical procedures and treatment administered to a woman in active labor

questions.subject: NP V
questions.stem: Under RA 10932, who must accompany an emergency patient transferred in an LGU ambulance?
questions.rationale: The hospital provides a staff nurse with ACLS certification or its equivalent to accompany the patient.
questions.source: RA 10932, amending BP 702 (Anti-Hospital Deposit Law), Sec. 3 (Lawphil)
questions.quote: must provide a staff nurse with advanced cardiovascular life support (ACLS) certification or its equivalent

questions.subject: NP V
questions.stem: Where are complaints against hospitals under the Anti-Hospital Deposit Law first filed?
questions.rationale: Complaints are first filed with the Health Facilities Oversight Board under the DOH HFSRB.
questions.source: RA 10932, amending BP 702 (Anti-Hospital Deposit Law), Sec. 5 (Lawphil)
questions.quote: shall be filed initially with the Health Facilities Oversight Board

questions.subject: NP IV
questions.stem: Under the Data Privacy Act, a patient's health record is classified as:
questions.rationale: Information about an individual's health is sensitive personal information, whose processing is generally prohibited except as allowed.
questions.source: RA 10173, Data Privacy Act of 2012, Sec. 3 (Lawphil)
questions.quote: About an individual's health, education, genetic or sexual life of a person

questions.subject: NP V
questions.stem: A nurse posts a photo of a psychiatric patient's chart on social media. Under RA 10173 this is:
questions.rationale: Disclosing sensitive personal information to third parties without consent is penalized.
questions.source: RA 10173, Data Privacy Act of 2012, Sec. 32 (Lawphil)
questions.quote: discloses to a third party sensitive personal information not covered by the immediately preceding section without the consent of the data subject

questions.subject: NP IV
questions.stem: An unconscious patient's records are shared with the ER team to save her life. Under RA 10173 this is:
questions.rationale: Processing sensitive data is allowed when needed to protect life and health and the person cannot consent.
questions.source: RA 10173, Data Privacy Act of 2012, Sec. 13(c) (Lawphil)
questions.quote: necessary to protect the life and health of the data subject or another person, and the data subject is not legally or physically able to express his or her consent

questions.subject: NP IV
questions.stem: Which nurse action breaks the Data Privacy Act?
options: Throwing patient lists in open trash
questions.rationale: Improper disposal of sensitive personal information (discarding it where others can access it) is penalized.
questions.source: RA 10173, Data Privacy Act of 2012, Sec. 27 (Lawphil)
questions.quote: knowingly or negligently dispose, discard or abandon the personal information of an individual

questions.subject: NP IV
questions.stem: Under RA 10912, CPD is a mandatory requirement for:
questions.rationale: CPD is mandatory for renewal of the Professional Identification Card of all PRC-regulated professionals.
questions.source: RA 10912, Continuing Professional Development Act of 2016, Sec. 10 (Lawphil)
questions.quote: The CPD is hereby made as a mandatory requirement in the renewal of the PICs

questions.subject: NP IV
questions.stem: Under RA 10912, the CPD Council for nursing is supervised by the:
questions.rationale: Each profession's CPD Council (a chair and 2 members) is under the supervision of its Professional Regulatory Board.
questions.source: RA 10912, Continuing Professional Development Act of 2016, Sec. 7 (Lawphil)
questions.quote: which shall be under the supervision of the concerned PRB
